text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the official Iraqi press on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Deputy Prime Minister Aziz meets Chinese and Russian U.N. ambassadors in New York.
- Ship loaded with Thai rice bought under oil-for- food deal arrives at Um Qasr port in southern Iraq.
- Group of French doctors in Baghdad to perform operations on ailing Iraqis.
- Large irrigation project commissioned in Dhiqar (Nasiriya) province in southern Iraq.
- Iraq to conduct experimental census on Friday in five Iraqi provinces.
(The above were also carried by IRAQ and QADISSIYA)
